items.text: Oil rigs now spawn only one boat group, cutting down excess boat traffic.
Gull AI overhauled: better tracking, larger flight area, stronger obstacle avoidance, smoother behavior, realistic landings, proper corpse handling.
Birds now glide when descending, flee distance increased to 1000 m for longer‑range reactions, and crows circle corpses from higher altitude, improving avian realism and explosion tracking.
UZI condition decay rate doubled, making the weapon wear out faster.
Fixed a crash caused by a null reference in the phone system, preventing errors when phones are destroyed.
Map markers are now more efficient: shop markers refresh only on data changes and monument markers are pre‑built, making the map open faster.
Fixed right‑to‑left text formatting and animal name display for RTL languages, ensuring proper localization.

2026-11-02.summary:
### Gameplay & AI
- Oil rigs now spawn only one boat group, cutting down excess boat traffic.
- Gull AI overhauled: better tracking, larger flight area, stronger obstacle avoidance, smoother behavior, realistic landings, proper corpse handling.
- Birds now glide when descending, flee distance increased to 1000 m for longer‑range reactions, and crows circle corpses from higher altitude, improving avian realism and explosion tracking.

### Weapon Balance
- UZI condition decay rate doubled, making the weapon wear out faster.

### Stability & Performance
- Fixed a crash caused by a null reference in the phone system, preventing errors when phones are destroyed.
- Map markers are now more efficient: shop markers refresh only on data changes and monument markers are pre‑built, making the map open faster.

### Localization
- Fixed right‑to‑left text formatting and animal name display for RTL languages, ensuring proper localization.
